name.en: RD Fund - Retinal Degeneration Fund (Foundation Fighting Blindness)

name.en: Global Health Investment Fund (GHIF) / Global Health Investment Corporation (GHIC)

strategy.thesis: A social-impact investment fund (structured by J.P. Morgan and the Gates Foundation, now managed by the Global Health Investment Corporation) that invests in companies developing vaccines, diagnostics, devices and drugs for diseases—HIV/AIDS, malaria, TB, cholera—that disproportionately burden low- and middle-income countries, while targeting financial returns.

summary.en: A $108M social-impact fund (structured by J.P. Morgan and the Gates Foundation, managed by GHIC) that invested in twelve companies developing vaccines, diagnostics, devices and therapeutics for diseases burdening low- and middle-income countries.
summary.local: 由摩根大通與蓋茲基金會設立、GHIC 管理的1.08億美元社會影響力基金，投資12家開發疫苗、診斷、醫材與療法的公司，鎖定影響中低收入國家的疾病（HIV、瘧疾、結核、霍亂）。

strategy.thesis: The commercial-research / venture philanthropy funding arm of the National MS Society, providing funding to biotech and pharma companies (as well as academic researchers) to accelerate MS drug development and bridge academia to commercial development.

summary.en: The commercial research / venture philanthropy funding entity of the National MS Society, funding biotech and academic MS drug-development programs to bridge the gap between research and commercial development.
summary.local: 美國全國多發性硬化症協會的商業研究/公益創投資助部門，資助生技公司與學術界的 MS 藥物開發，銜接研究與商業化。

name.en: DELSIA - Delivering Scientific Innovation for Autism (Autism Speaks)

aka: Delivering Scientific Innovation for Autism LLC

strategy.thesis: The not-for-profit venture philanthropy affiliate of Autism Speaks, partnering with for-profit companies to fund development of drugs, diagnostics and therapeutic/assistive devices aligned with the unmet medical and behavioral-health needs of the autism community.

summary.en: The venture philanthropy affiliate of Autism Speaks (est. 2012), funding for-profit development of autism drugs, diagnostics and devices; early investments included a $2M award to Seaside Therapeutics and a collaboration with Akili Interactive.
summary.local: Autism Speaks 的公益創投附屬機構（2012年成立），資助自閉症藥物、診斷與醫材的商業開發；早期投資包括對 Seaside Therapeutics 的200萬美元資助，以及與 Akili Interactive 的合作。
